name: Taohelong
isnote: Described as a polacanthine nodosaurid, sister to Polacanthus (Yang et al. 2013); polacanthine placement is disputed, so it is placed in Ankylosauria.
sum: Taohelong is an Early Cretaceous armoured dinosaur from Gansu, China, the first polacanthine found in Asia, with an irregular sacral shield.
holotype: GSDM 00021, with a middle caudal vertebra, ribs, a left ilium and armour pieces — Hekou Group, Lanzhou-Minhe Basin, Gansu.
biology: Known from fragmentary remains; the sources give no direct biological data.
author: Yang et al. 2013

sources.text: Yang, J.-T.; You, H.-L.; Li, D.-Q.; Kong, D.-L. 2013. First discovery of polacanthine ankylosaur dinosaur in Asia. Vertebrata PalAsiatica 51(4): 265–277.
